instruction: In the IncomeStatement2 spreadsheet, identify the year with the highest Gross Profit and write that year value in cell K2.

metadata.explanation: Task asks to find year with maximum Gross Profit. Verified with Python: Year 2019 has highest GP (62864).

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification coverage: Instruction requires (1) identifying the year with highest Gross Profit AND (2) writing it to K2, but evaluator only verifies requirement #2
No verification of analysis step: Evaluator checks if K2 contains 2019 but doesn't verify that 2019 is actually the year with maximum Gross Profit from the spreadsheet data
Agent could hardcode 2019 in K2 without performing any analysis and still pass verification
Expected value 2019 is claimed to be verified externally but the evaluator doesn't perform runtime validation of this claim against actual Gross Profit data
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add a getter to extract all Gross Profit values with their corresponding years from the spreadsheet
Add logic to the metric to verify that the year in K2 corresponds to the maximum Gross Profit value
Alternative: Use a metric that compares the extracted Gross Profit data to find the max year, then verify K2 contains that result
Consider using existing functions like get_xlsx_cell_range to read Gross Profit column and year column, then verify K2 = year_of_max(Gross_Profit)
